CrystallizedRichNuggetCountComment: Nugget count for rich crystallized ore quality.
CrystallizedBountifulNuggetCountComment: Nugget count for bountiful crystallized ore quality.
StandardPoorNuggetCountComment: Nugget count for poor non-crystallized ore quality.
StandardMediumNuggetCountComment: Nugget count for medium non-crystallized ore quality.
StandardRichNuggetCountComment: Nugget count for rich non-crystallized ore quality.
StandardBountifulNuggetCountComment: Nugget count for bountiful non-crystallized ore quality.
BlacklistedHammerNamesComment: List of hammer item names that cannot be used to crush ores.
